entries.title: II Timothy 2:1
segments: Therefore, my son, be strong in the grace [that is] in Christ Jesus.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:2
segments: And the things that you have heard from me among many witnesses, commit the same to faithful men who will be able to teach others also.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:3
segments: Therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:4
segments: No one who wars tangles with the affairs of [this] life, that he may please him who chose [him] to be a soldier.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:5
segments: And also if anyone competes, he is not crowned unless he competes lawfully.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:6
segments: It is right for the laboring farmer to partake first of the fruits.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:7
segments: Consider what I say, and the Lord will give you understanding in all things.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:8
segments: Remember that Jesus Christ of the seed of David was raised from [the] dead according to my gospel,

entries.title: II Timothy 2:9
segments: in which I suffer ill as an evildoer, [even] to bonds. But the Word of God is not chained.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:10
segments: Therefore I endure all things for the sake of the elect, that they may also obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:11
segments: Faithful [is] the word, for if we are dead with [Him], we shall also live with [Him].

entries.title: II Timothy 2:12
segments: If we suffer, we shall also reign with [Him]. If we deny [Him], He also will deny us.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:13
segments: If we do not believe [Him], [yet] He remains faithful; He cannot deny Himself.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:14
segments: Put [them] in memory of these things, charging them before the Lord not to dispute about words to no profit, to the subverting of the hearers.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:15
segments: [Study] earnestly to present yourself approved to God, a workman that does not need to be ashamed, rightly dividing the Word of Truth.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:16
segments: But shun profane, vain babblings, for they will increase to more ungodliness.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:17
segments: And their word will eat like a gangrene; among whom [are] Hymeneus and Philetus,

entries.title: II Timothy 2:18
segments: who have erred concerning the truth, saying that the resurrection is already past, and who overthrow the faith of some.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:19
segments: Nevertheless the foundation of God stands sure, having this seal: "[The] Lord knew those who are His." And, "Let everyone who names the name of Christ depart from iniquity!"

entries.title: II Timothy 2:20
segments: But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth; and some to honor, and some to dishonor.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:21
segments: Therefore if anyone purges himself from these, he shall be a vessel to honor, sanctified and useful to the Master, prepared for every good work.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:22
segments: But flee youthful lusts, and follow righteousness, faith, love, peace, with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:23
segments: But avoid foolish and unlearned questions, knowing that they give birth to strifes.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:24
segments: But the servant of [the] Lord must not strive, but to be gentle to all, apt to teach, patient,

entries.title: II Timothy 2:25
segments: in meekness instructing those who oppose, if perhaps God will give them repentance to the acknowledging of [the] truth,

entries.title: II Timothy 2:26
segments: and [that] they awake out of the snare of the Devil, having been taken captive by him, so as to do the will of that one.
